extension.summary: Create custom TV channels from your Kodi library
extension.description: Turn your own Kodi library into channels that play like broadcast TV. Build TV show channels (round robin or serial), movie, folder, audio and party channels, each with a rolling queue that is topped up as items play. Mix channels together by interleaving items from other channels, combine different content in Combo Blocks, schedule blocks of programming, and let a channel resume where you left off. Works with the local files in your library and with shared network storage.
extension.news: 3.1.110: a channel another device is playing cannot be edited, reset or deleted from here; the free-channel notice also arrives while you watch something else. 3.1.109: only one device at a time can play a channel; a second device is told, and gets a notice when the channel is free. 3.1.108: a Combo Block TV slot with several shows can now take turns, one show per cycle. 3.1.107: Combo Block TV slots no longer draw an episode that is already waiting in the queue. 3.1.106: a scheduled block now reloads the playing channel even when old blocks are left over in the saved state. 3.1.105: choosing a drive-letter folder (D:\) now warns that other devices cannot open it. 3.1.104: a scheduled Combo Block now plays as a whole block, each slot in order. 3.1.103: a schedule now fires only on the device that is playing its target channel. 3.1.102: a show missing from a TV channel queue is put back automatically after start; the shared storage message is logged once. 3.1.101: the missing durations viewers show a proper empty message and correct episode details. 3.1.100: an episode with an unreadable duration is skipped and logged instead of shrinking the queue. 3.1.99: filters gain is, is not, contains and equals, greater than, less than comparisons; AND binds before OR. 3.1.98: changing the Shared storage path now offers the data copy the first time. 3.1.97: folder pickers for the shared, backup and icon folders. 3.1.96: network folder paths for icons and ffprobe. 3.1.95: Backup and Restore accept Windows network paths. 3.1.94: Repair Queue Paths.
